tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma zhi drag gi las byang dang gtor dbang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa snga 'gyur la mos pa lam du byed kyang blo gros kyi lang tsho ches cher mi ngom pa dag gam/ yang na shes rab kyi pad+ma zla phung gi ba mos rnying par byas pa 'ga' zhig gis gter kha so so nas 'byung ba'i bla ma zhi drag gi dbang dang las byang rnams glo bar 'dzud par ma nus pa dag gis ni| de dag gi nyes pa bzlog pa'i slad du 'dir bla ma zhi drag gi dbang dang las byang dkyus gcig gis bya ba'i tshul shin tu bsdus pa ni/ gnas dben par zhi drag gang dgos kyi gtor ma bris skus brgyan pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka mdun du mchod pa bshams la/ ḍā ru rdor dril las bum sogs 'du byas la/ stan bde bar 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems cad rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// gsum dang*/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyi// 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca'o// gsum/ bdun rnam dag ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*// smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor// mya ngan mi mda' gzhan don bzhugs// snying po sems can don phyir bsngo// yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /gsum/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ hūm̐ */ rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du// dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i bgegs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la// gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// suṃ bha ni sogs brjod/ mtshams gcod pa ni/

hūm̐ */ nga ni ye nas ngang gi khro// mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang*// bgegs 'dul khro mo'i rol mtshams las// su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ mchod pa rnams raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+yaṃ shapad āḥhūm̐// zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ gsum gsum gyis sman raka gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ byin dbab pa ni/ spos sreg rol mo bsgrags dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings las du mar sprul// rang rtsal bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// thugs dam brtser dgongs byin chen phobs// oṃ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa ma ya dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes dbab/ dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gsum dang 'byung rim bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ chos rnams dmigs med stong pa'i ngang*// 'gro la byams dang snying brtse sgom// rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥlas ni// e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las// nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i steng*// rin chen las grub ri rab kyi| |lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba ru/ */zhes pa'i yan chod zhi drag thun mong dang*/ dang po zhi ba'i skabs/ bh+rūṃ las rin chen gzhal yas khang*// mtshan nyid kun ldan 'od zer 'bar| |bsrung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i nang*// rang rig rgyu yi hrīḥyig ni// yongs gyur bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung*// dkar dmar byis pa'i lang tsho can// phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod// g.yon pas lte 'og mnyam bzhag steng*// dung chen bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams// dbu la pad zhu rgod sgro dang*// dar sna me long 'od zer 'phro// za 'og ber dang dar dmar gyi// chos gos phod chen mthing ga mnabs// snyan dang phyag zhabs mgul sked sogs// gser gyi rgyan cha sna tshogs brjid// rdo rje'i skyil krung 'gying tshul bzhugs// mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ sgreng*// 'khor du thod phreng rigs bzhi dang*// mtshan brgyad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// ging dang bka' srung dregs pas bskor// char sprin dkrigs pa lta bur gsal| |zhes so// drag dmar la/

bh+rūṃ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// lha klu sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs// bsgral ba'i gzhal yas rab 'bar nang*// khrag chen mtsho dbus pad+ma dang*// zla nyi dregs pa bsnol ba'i steng*// rang rig hrīḥlas rdzogs pa'i sku// dbang drag 'bar ba me phreng can// ri rab me chen 'bar ba ltar// rab brjid zhal bsgrad mche ba gtsigs// spyan gsum dmar zhing me ltar 'bar// dbu skra smin ma ag tshom 'bar// phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas lcags sdig 'gyed pa'i tshul// thod pa skam rlon dur khrod chas| |rus pa'i phyag rgya rnam pa lnga// zhing glang stag lpags brjid par mnabs// spyi bor snang ba mtha' yas te// me yi khyung dmar mkha' la 'phyo// dpral bar gshin rje mgrin pa ru| |rta mgrin thugs kar gsang ba'i bdag /lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang*// gsang gnas yak+sha me dbal rnams// rang rang cha lugs me 'od 'bar// brkyang bskum ye shes me klong bsgyings// 'khor du rigs bzhi sras mchog bzhi// khro bcu sgo srung dregs pas bskor// zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro// 'di man chad zhi drag thun mong du sbyar ro// de ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyi// sku gsung thugs las 'od 'phros pas// lho nub rnga yab gling mchog nas// rtsa gsum bla ma spyan drangs bstim// spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐ */ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams| |pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyi// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ gzhal yas brjid ldan mdzes pa'i dbus// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// bdag cag sgo gsum dang ba yi// rdul snyed lus sprul phyag bgyi'o// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri dang zhal zas dang*// rnga dung rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchog /rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i rak+ta dang*// ba ling brjid ldan mchod pa 'bul// yab yum snyoms 'jug dga' bde'i mchog /de don bde stong lhan cig skyes// rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol// ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+yaṃ shapad pū dza hoḥ pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi/ a nu rā ga yā mi ma hā mu dra pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /āḥ grag cing stong la stong zhing grag /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ stong zhing gsal la gsal zhing stong*// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod| |yon tan mtha' yas mnga' bdag khyod// phrin las 'gro ba 'dul la bstod// ces bstod nas dzab bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ snang ba thams cad bla ma'i sku// gdod nas grub pa a la la| |grag pa thams cad bla ma'i gsung*/ /rlung sngags dbyer med nā da'i dbyangs// dran rtog thams cad bla ma'i thugs// ye nas chos sku ka nas dag /stong gsum dzab gyi rang sgra sgrog |spros pas 'gro ba'i don byas shing*// bsdus nas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing bsgom// ma grub bar du mi btang ngo*// zhi ba la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi haṃ'u/ zhes dang*/ spro na thod phreng dang hrī ma yang bzla/ drag po la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas/ tshogs rdzas la sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros tshogs rdzas sbyangs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha hoḥhrīḥ

/dkar dmar mthing 'phros bdud rtsir bsgyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ gnyis pa btab pa ni/ hrīḥ bdag cag mchog sgrub rnal 'byor la// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs 'dir khug la// snying rjes bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ gtum chen sprul pa'i tshogs la stobs/ */ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti ba su ta go ro tsa na tsit+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gsum pa bskang bshags ni/ hūm̐ */ 'dod yon tshogs dang phyi nang gsang*// sbyor sgrol mchod pa rmad byung ba// rtsa gsum bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /yig brgya brjod/ tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus par sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ phud dang tshogs dang lhag ma bcas| |rtsa gsum mched lcam pho nya rnams// nyer spyod 'os pa'i longs spyod 'di// lhag mar dbang ba rnams la 'bul// u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes dbul/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin na bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang yig brgya bzlas pa'i chus khrus bya/ gral la bkod/ me tog bkram zhing bgegs gtor byin/ bka' bsgo/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas thog mar zhi ba'i dbang ni/ lo rgyus bshad nas/ las gzhung ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa lan gsum gsum bya/ slob ma zhi bar bskyed/ tshig bdun mas byin dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ slar slob mas/ na mo/ brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs ni// skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol// gsum brjod/ bla mas gtor ma lhar gsal ba thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// gu ru'i sku dang bdud rtsi 'du 'bral med// 'gyur med sku dbang ma hā gu ru'i sku// skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/

zhes dpral bar bskur/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// gu ru'i gsung dang bdud rtsi 'du 'bral med// 'gag med gsung dbang ma hā gu ru'i gsung*// skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes mgrin par bskur/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā lar// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// gu ru'i thugs dang bdud rtsi 'du 'bral med// 'khrul med thugs dbang ma hā gu ru'i thugs// skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes snying khar bskur/ hūm̐ */ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pad+ma 'byung gnas ni// dad mos can la spyi bor dngos su 'byon// pad+ma lta bur dri med bzhi pa'i dbang*// skal ldan bu mchog 'di la stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ zhes mgo bor bzhag /dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ rjes su/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo/// / ༈ /drag po'i gtor dbang byed na byin 'bebs yan zhi ba ltar la/ skabs 'dir gong gi gsol gdab mi dgos/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas drag po'i sku mchog gi// oṃ dkar 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// lus sgrib sbyangs nas sprul sku thob/ */oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hū?ṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes spyi bor bskur/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba ru/ /dam rdzas drag po'i gsung mchog gi// āḥdamar 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// ngag sgrib sbyangs nas longs sku thob// oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ

zhes mgrin par bskur/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas drag po'i thugs mchog gi// hūm̐ mthing 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// yid sgrib sbyangs nas chos sku thob// oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes snying khar bskur/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas bla ma'i ngo bo nyid// sku gsung thugs dbang yongs rdzogs nas// dbang bzhi sku bzhi thob par shog /oṃ āḥ hūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ zhes mgo bor bskur/ dag pa spyi ltar bshad/ sngags lung sbyin/ rjes rnams zhi ba dang 'dra'o// mthar thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings ngang las rab bzhengs pa'i// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas// thugs dam bskul lo phrin las mdzod// bar chad sol la dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ chad mdo ni/ gtor chung la sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam bcas srung ma'i tshogs// mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod// oṃ dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta ba ling+ta ta khā hi/ zhes gtor ma 'bul/ gtor gzhong bshal ba sman 'bru dang bcas/ brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ gtso chen 'bar bas bka' bsgos pa'i// bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs bdud rtsi 'bar ba bzhes// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ḍā ki nī tiṣ+ṭha sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ gtor gzhong sbub la/ oṃ nan/ āḥnan/ hūm̐ nan/ s+t+waṃ bha rak+ṣa ku ru nan/ slar sman 'brus bkang*/ hūm̐ */ theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas// chad lhag nongs pa'i dri ma dang*// shes dang shes min gang byung ba/

lha mchog rnams la bzod par gsol/ /yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐ */ rang bzhin med par der snang ba// sgyu ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor lha// chos dbyings rang bzhin gnas su bsdu| |bzo med lhug mnyam a la la// zhes bsdu/ hoḥ kun bzang nas bzung rtsa brgyud kyi// byin rlabs bla ma'i bkra shis shog /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha// dngos grub rnam gnyis bkra shis shog /ma sring mkha' 'gro shugs 'gror bcas// phrin las grub pa'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong dam can dregs pa'i tshogs// dgra bgegs tshar gcod bkra shis shog /ces dang bsngo smon bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// smras pa/ tshig gcig tshig la tshig brgya'ang tshig /de bzhin legs bshad don tshang na// rgyas bsdus gang yang rnam dag nyid/ de phyir 'di yang mi 'gal snyam// 'di dge blo dman tshogs rnams kyang*| |bla ma zhi drag sgrub pa'i lam// brten nas mtha' yas 'gro bar bcas// rdo rje 'dzin dbang thob par shog /ces bla ma zhi drag gi las byang gtor dbang dkyus gcig la skabs thob so sor dbye ba shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ blo dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ 'bri gung pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam la blo gros smin pa/ chos kyi grags pas me byi mgo zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum par/ dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang chen po bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba yin no/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bla ma zhi ba pad+ma gling pa'i gter kha'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ lha lcam pad+ma gsal/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ grub thob tshe 'phel bzang po// rgyal dbang gnam lcags me 'bar/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma des bdag la'o/// / ༈ /drag po dmar chen mnga' bdag nyang gi gter kha'i brgyud pa ni/

chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ grub thob me long ras pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis/ bla ma dkon mchog bshes gnyen/ rtogs ldan kun dga' gzhon nu/ mkhas grub byams pa rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan bkra shis/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'o ma/ sngags 'chang zla ba 'od zer/ bla ma dga' ba'i mtshan can/ rje btsun rat+na'i mtshan can/ mnyam med chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma des bdag la'o// //maṅga laṃ//
